source.note: Provisional 36-card draft imported from the hosted Card Editor. Rules v17 adds chosen route cuts, buffs Green/Blue spending, and makes Purple spending burn an opposing main on hit, 2026-10-14. Local rules v38 strengthens Bait and Slip, adds persistent main-card hand relocation, orb overfill, and empty-hand defeat. Local rules v39 gives Grip Break independent defensive-bonus and carried-momentum reads, with either objective path earning Blue. No runtime credentials required.

cards.name: Quick Jab
cards.ability:
If you committed no bonus burns this round, gain +2 attack this round.
If you committed no bonus burns this round, for your damage calculation ignore block gained from reaction burns this round.

cards.name: Rushdown
cards.ability: Spend Red advantage: If you deal damage, gain +2 attack next round.
cards.bonus: Gain +3 attack this round. Your opponent gains +1 attack this round.

cards.name: Guarded Strike
cards.ability:
If you take no combat damage, deal 2 damage to your opponent after combat damage.
Objective: Deal damage and take no damage: gain Green advantage.

cards.name: Feint
cards.ability:
If your opponent's main card has a printed block value of 4 or more, gain +2 attack and ignore 3 opposing block this round.
Objective: Deal damage against printed block 4+: gain Yellow advantage.
cards.bonus: If your opponent's main card has a printed block value of 4 or more, gain +3 attack this round. Otherwise, gain +1 attack this round.

cards.name: Combination Strike
cards.ability: Spend up to two different advantages: One spent: +1 attack. Two spent instead: +4 attack, +2 block, and ignore 2 opposing block this round.

cards.name: Covering Step
cards.ability:
If your opponent's main card has a printed attack value of 5 or more, gain +2 block this round.
Objective: Take no damage against printed attack 5+: gain Red advantage.

cards.name: Clinch Throw
cards.ability:
For your damage calculation this round, treat your opponent's block as 2 lower, to a minimum of 0.
Spend Orange advantage: If you deal damage, your opponent cannot burn bonus or reaction cards next round.
cards.bonus: For your damage calculation this round, treat your opponent's block as 2 lower, to a minimum of 0.

cards.name: Body Lock
cards.ability:
If your opponent's main card has a printed block value of 4 or more, gain +3 attack this round.
Objective: Deal damage against printed block 4+: gain Orange advantage.

cards.name: Driving Tackle
cards.ability: Spend Orange advantage: Ignore 2 opposing block this round. If you deal damage, choose one opposing legal next color to prohibit if more than one is available.
cards.bonus: Gain +3 attack this round. Your opponent gains +1 block this round.

cards.name: Grip Break
cards.ability:
If your opponent committed a block-increasing bonus burn this round, gain +2 attack and +1 block this round.
If your opponent has an attack bonus carried into this round, gain +3 block this round.
Objective: Deal damage against a block-increasing bonus burn, or take no damage against an opponent with an attack bonus carried into this round: gain Blue advantage.

cards.name: Off-Balance Sweep
cards.ability:
If your opponent's main card has a printed attack value of 3 or less, gain +3 attack this round.
Objective: Deal damage against printed attack 3 or less: gain Yellow advantage.
cards.bonus: Gain +1 attack and +1 block this round.

cards.name: Counter Throw

cards.name: Darting Strike
cards.ability: Spend Yellow advantage: After reveal, before reactions, you may permanently burn this card and replace it with another available main from your Yellow hand. Keep your committed bonus. The replacement cannot spend advantage.

cards.name: Bait and Slip
cards.ability:
If your opponent committed at least one bonus burn this round, gain +4 block this round.
If your opponent committed at least one bonus burn this round, you may return their main card to a different hand of your choice after damage.
Objective: Take no damage against a bonus burn: gain Blue advantage.
cards.bonus: Gain +1 attack and +1 block this round.
cards.reaction: If your opponent committed at least one bonus burn this round, gain +2 block this round. Otherwise, gain +1 block this round.
